name: Blocky
summary: Shopify fraud filter that blocks visitors and orders by country, IP (v4 and v6), email, name, address and phone, with an AI bot blocker for TOR, proxy and VPN traffic that gets past reCAPTCHA, country redirects, a right-click blocker and visitor analytics. Not sold to Shopify Plus stores.
best_for: Shopify stores below Plus that are losing time to bot traffic, repeat fraudsters or orders from regions they do not ship to, and want blocking rules they control rather than a full security suite
skip_if: you are on Shopify Plus, where the paid plans exclude you outright, or you need chargebacks disputed and revenue recovered rather than visitors kept out
honest_knock:
Read the plan text before you read the badge. The App Store header says a free plan is available; that free plan is Development Stores, for development and partner stores only, and it starts charging the moment the store goes live. All three paid tiers then carry the line 'all stores except for Shopify Plus stores', so if you are on Plus this app is not sold to you. Check that with the developer before you plan around it.

A blocker is a blunt instrument, and the review distribution shows it: 355 reviews read on 5 October 2026, 89% of them at the top rating and 5% at the bottom: eighteen one-star reviews, three of them added between late August and mid-September. Rules that stop fraud also stop customers. A blocked country catches the expat who wanted to buy; a VPN rule catches the privacy-minded shopper. The tuning is yours to do, continuously, using visitor analytics that only the Pro tier includes.

And it prevents rather than recovers. Nothing here disputes a chargeback that has already landed or claws back an order that already shipped. For that you need a separate dispute tool, which is a second subscription on top of this one.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Basic Plan · per month (or $67.11 a year) for unlimited country and IP blocking plus the Bot Killer
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-11-02 on apps.shopify.com/blocky-simple-country-blocker) Four tiers, each paid one with a 7-day free trial. The ladder was repriced after our 5 October reading: Advanced is cheaper and every annual price is now a stated 50% saving. Development Stores is free but only for development and partner stores; it carries all Pro features and starts billing on upgrade. Basic $9.99 a month or $59.94 a year: enforcement inside the checkout page, unlimited country blocking, a fully customisable blocked page and online support. Advanced $12.99 a month (was $16.99) or $77.94 a year adds unlimited IP blocking for IPv4, IPv6 and IP ranges, an IP whitelist and a geo redirect by country. Pro $19.99 a month or $119.94 a year adds blocking by email, name, address and phone, the Bot Killer for TOR, proxy and VPN traffic, an add-ons blocker, a right-click blocker and unlimited visitor analytics traffic logs. All three paid tiers carry the same restriction in their own plan text: all stores except for Shopify Plus stores. All charges are billed in USD and recur every 30 days. Developer Effective Apps, 13 Max Nordau, Ashdod, 7722119, Israel; the app launched 7 April 2021, still carries Shopify's “Built for Shopify” badge and is available in eleven languages. The review record keeps moving: 362 reviews averaging 4.7 on 2 November 2026, up from 324 on 22 August, 346 on 18 September and 355 on 5 October, distributed 322 five-star, 16 four-star, 3 three-star, 1 two-star and 20 one-star — two more one-star reviews than in October. The developer replies to reviews on the listing, including an August 2026 reply explaining what the Basic plan is meant to cover.
